FN-67JK311-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 154
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/19/2024
Senate Bill 154 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain county commissions, by
an undetermined amount, if the respective county commissions provide a salary increase for the
sheriff of the county effective beginning with the next term of office of the sheriff as authorized
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 154
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/15/2024
Senate Bill 154 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of certain county
commissions by an undetermined amount dependent on any compensation increase provided by
the respective county commissions for the sheriff of the county as authorized pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
